title.zh: 质量各操作系统及SDK版本分布
title.en: Version Distribution by Operating System and SDK for Quality Metrics

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取质量统计中各操作系统及SDK版本的分布数据。使用该接口时，限制如下：
- 支持查询最近365天（不包含查询当天）任意范围的数据。
- 如果查询范围小于24小时，则按小时统计查询的数据；如果查询范围大于或等于24小时，则按天统计查询的数据。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To
This API is used to obtain the distribution data of operating systems and SDK versions in quality statistics. When using this API, the following restrictions apply:
- You can query data for any period within the last 365 days (excluding the current day).
- If the query range is less than 24 hours, the data is aggregated by hour. If the query range is greater than or equal to 24 hours, the data is aggregated by day.
### QPS Limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
